mainEntity.name: What is foundation work for an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foundation work for an addition involves constructing a new base to support the structural load of the new living space. This typically includes excavating, pouring concrete footings, and building stem walls or a slab-on-grade. The type of foundation required depends on factors such as soil conditions, the size and weight of the addition, and local building codes. It's a critical first step to ensure the long-term stability and safety of your new space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation work for an addition involves constructing a new base for the structure, including excavation, footings, and walls, based on soil conditions and building codes.
